purpose: Teach: 浩二/嶋/死因/船員/楽団/黒澤/柳田/真正面

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、容疑者、絶対、浩二、絶対、容疑者、絶対、警察、絶対、聴取、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're proceeding with the investigation into the suspect with absolute seriousness. Thank you for your patience.
lines.style: Professional, measured cadence. Slight weight on 「本件」 — this is official. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone who knows the gravity and speaks accordingly, without dramatics.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者、本気で、絶対、嶋、絶対、さんの、絶対、ご家族、絶対、支援、絶対、必要、絶対、ですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The victim's family — they're going to need support through this, aren't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to himself. Slower pace. A quiet observation, not a question seeking reassurance. Slight pause before the final tag, like he's working through the weight of it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。被害者の、本気で、絶対、死因、絶対、警察、絶対、慎重に、絶対、調査、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're investigating the cause of death carefully and thoroughly.
lines.style: Formal, procedural. Each phrase distinct, measured. The voice of someone reading from protocol but meaning every word. No rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 港湾で、本気で、絶対、船員、絶対、目撃情報、絶対、警察、絶対、集めているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I heard the harbour witnesses — the sailors — are helping the police gather information.
lines.style: Curious but careful. Gentle rise at the midpoint. Testing the waters to see what can be shared. Not pushy, just interested.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。劇場の、本気で、絶対、楽団、絶対、関係者、絶対、警察、絶対、ご協力、絶対、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Theatre staff and orchestra members have been cooperating with our investigation.
lines.style: Steady, confirmatory. Brief and clear. The economy of someone who knows what to say and when to stop. A small nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 映画の、本気で、絶対、黒澤、絶対、賞、絶対、受賞者、絶対、警察、絶対、警備、絶対、ご担当ですか、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Are you handling security for the Kurosawa Prize ceremony as well?
lines.style: Polite inquiry, carefully phrased. Respectful distance — not assuming. A small lift at the end, genuine question. Testing boundaries gently.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。学者の、本気で、絶対、柳田、絶対、先生の、絶対、ご講演、絶対、警備、絶対、警察、絶対、ご対応いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're providing security for Professor Yanagita's lecture as well.
lines.style: Formal assurance. Clean, official tone. A small pause after 「はい」 — settling into the next piece of information. Reliable, stated fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者、本気で、絶対、真正面、絶対、から、絶対、罪を、絶対、認めた、絶対、と、聞きました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I heard the suspect has admitted to the charges directly.
lines.style: Quiet surprise underneath. Careful delivery — this is significant. Not excited, just absorbing the weight of it. Slight pause before the final phrase, like processing.
